blocks.text: Harbor & Oak checkout test strategy

This is the working cut for HBR-TST-2022-041 on July 21, 2022. Jenna Park asked for a written bound after the current path (Manual checkout on preview theme, no CI case for wrap) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host stg-shop.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on record a production checkout as a fixture, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Block-merge cases: pickup rate present, wrap app absent on flagged weekends, gift card tender, GA4 purchase fires once. Fixtures invented, no live orders in CI. I am not restating a hallway yes. record a production checkout as a fixture is out because A live order in CI is how we almost emailed a real customer from staging in June. Paige caught it. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at cases=4, wrap=1, ga4=1, hours=0.9, weeks=3, live=0, miss=17.4, pixels=1. Sibling tickets HBR-2988 and HBR-INC-2021-044. I will not reopen record a production checkout as a fixture in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
